Stephanie Bryan was behind the wheel for electric bus company The Big Lemon when she allegedly produced ‘significant flatulence’. An ‘episode’ ensued, a tribunal heard, with co-worker Samantha Bingham noticing the lingering odour when she started her shift and sat in the same seat…

items.title_en: Where to See the World’s Most Famous Preserved Body Parts
items.title_zh: 哪里可以看到世界上最著名的保存完好的身体部位
items.summary_en: Sure, you’ve seen a dead body before, but have you ever seen a thumb preserved in salt? How about a saint’s heart shrouded in gold? Beyond the normal displays of skeletons in medical museums and holy leaders’ bodies in churches and temples, there’s a whole world of bits and pieces to explore. Throughout history, body parts have been taken as trophies during wartime, worshipped as miraculous healing agents, cut off and displayed to honor their owners, or simply saved incidentally by natural processes.
items.summary_zh: 当然，你以前见过尸体，但你见过保存在盐里的拇指吗？圣人的心被金子包裹着怎么样？除了医学博物馆中正常展示的骨骼以及教堂和寺庙中神圣领袖尸体的展示之外，还有一个充满碎片的世界可供探索。纵观历史，身体部位在战时被当作战利品，被当作神奇的治愈剂来崇拜，被砍下来并展示以纪念它们的主人，或者只是简单地保存下来。

items.title_en: The Breakers: Inside The Opulent Gilded Age Mansion Built By Cornelius Vanderbilt II
items.title_zh: 破碎者：科尼利厄斯·范德比尔特二世 (Cornelius Vanderbilt II) 建造的华丽镀金时代豪宅内部
items.summary_en: Click here to view slideshow The enchanting Breakers mansion in Newport, Rhode Island, is the epitome of Gilded Age luxury. Built by Cornelius Vanderbilt II, then one of the richest men in America, the 70-room mansion was a stunning summer getaway for the wealthy Vanderbilt family. The mansion's classic Italian Renaissance design and brilliant ocean views made it a beloved residence for the family for years. But after Cornelius' death in 1899, his family faced increasingly rising costs to maintain the residence.
items.summary_zh: 单击此处观看幻灯片 位于罗德岛州纽波特的迷人 Breakers 豪宅是镀金时代奢华的缩影。这座拥有 70 个房间的豪宅由当时美国最富有的人之一科尼利厄斯·范德比尔特二世 (Cornelius Vanderbilt II) 建造，是富有的范德比尔特家族 (Vanderbilt family) 的绝佳避暑胜地。这座豪宅采用经典的意大利文艺复兴时期设计，享有壮丽的海景，多年来一直是该家族心爱的住所。但 1899 年科尼利厄斯去世后，他的家人面临着越来越多的苦难。

items.title_en: Paul John Knowles, The Vicious Serial Killer Known As The ‘Casanova Killer’
items.title_zh: 保罗·约翰·诺尔斯，被称为“卡萨诺瓦杀手”的邪恶连环杀手
items.summary_en: Wikimedia Commons Paul John Knowles, smoking a cigarette in a photo taken after he was arrested. At first glance, Paul John Knowles seemed charming and handsome. One woman even referred to him as “a cross between Robert Redford and Ryan O’Neal.” But Knowles was actually a vicious, remorseless serial killer. In 1974, he killed at least 18 people — and perhaps as many as 35.
items.summary_zh: 维基共享资源中的保罗·约翰·诺尔斯在被捕后拍摄的一张抽烟的照片中。乍一看，保罗·约翰·诺尔斯显得迷人又英俊。一位女士甚至称他为“罗伯特·雷德福和瑞安·奥尼尔的结合体”。但诺尔斯实际上是一个恶毒、无情的连环杀手。 1974 年，他杀害了至少 18 人，或许多达 35 人。

items.title_en: Michael Malloy Was Murdered In An Insurance Scam — But It Took His Killers Many Attempts To Finish The Job
items.title_zh: 迈克尔·马洛伊在一场保险骗局中被谋杀——但凶手经过多次尝试才完成这项工作
items.summary_en: Wikimedia Commons Tony Marino’s speakeasy, where the “Murder Trust” hatched their plan to kill Mike Malloy. Michael Malloy was like a lot of down-on-their-luck, unemployed men in New York City during the Great Depression. Lacking a steady job or a place to live, he spent most of his time at a local speakeasy. But he became known as the “Rasputin of the Bronx” because, in the 1930s, Malloy somehow survived multiple murder attempts.
items.summary_zh: 维基共享资源 托尼·马里诺的地下酒吧，“谋杀信托”策划了刺杀迈克·马洛伊的计划。迈克尔·马洛伊就像大萧条时期纽约市许多运气不佳、失业的人一样。由于缺乏稳定的工作或住所，他大部分时间都在当地的一家地下酒吧度过。但他被称为“布朗克斯的拉斯普京”，因为在 20 世纪 30 年代，马洛伊以某种方式在多次谋杀企图中幸存下来。
